title: Glass Shelf 16-Inch Double Wall Mount With Gallery Rail, Solid Brass Hardware | Satin Brass | Waverly Place | Allied Brass
description:
Free up vanity space with a wall-mounted glass shelf that keeps everyday bathroom items organized and easy to reach in Satin Brass, which combines warm golden tones with a brushed texture, bringing modern warmth without the high shine of polished brass. This double glass shelf (also called a bathroom wall shelf or floating shelf) adds storage while maintaining a clean, transitional look—ideal for matching Waverly Place and other transitional bathroom hardware.

Highlights:
- Satin Brass brings warm, timeless elegance
- Coordinates beautifully with other Waverly Place hardware in the same finish
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Choose a coordinated style for transitional bath accessories in the Waverly Place collection
- Get a neat, finished install with concealed screw mounting hardware (wall mount / wall-mounted / wall hanging)

Specs & Installation:
- Glass dimensions (each shelf): 16 x 5 inches
- Overall size: 16 in length x 8 in height x 5 in projection
- Weight capacity: 4 lb
- Material: solid brass hardware (brass construction) with tempered glass shelves
- Mounting type: wall mount
- Assembly required: no
- Included: glass shelf set and all installation hardware; screw size #8 x 1 1/4"
multiple designer finish options available to complement grooved bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories
